definitions.explanation: A specific point or aspect where statements, facts, or logic are contradictory or inconsistent. Used in argumentation, analysis, and investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several inconsistencies in this report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The lawyer pointed out the contradictions in the testimony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}い{出|だ}して→洗い出す：27520_araidasu⟧、{実現可能|じつげんかのう}な⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to identify the inconsistencies in the plan and revise it into something feasible.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧ (contradiction) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point, aspect). The suffix ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ narrows the focus to a specific aspect or instance of contradiction, making this word more concrete than ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧ alone. Part of the productive X⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ pattern: ⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧ (problem point), {改善点|かいぜんてん} (point for improvement), ⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧ (point of difference).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧: to point out an inconsistency
- {矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}い{出|だ}す→洗い出す：27520_araidasu⟧: to identify contradictions
- {矛盾点|むじゅんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: for an inconsistency to be found

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧: contradiction — the general concept, while {矛盾点|むじゅんてん} refers to a specific instance or detail
- ⟦{食|く}い{違|ちが}い→食い違い：09342_kuichigai⟧: discrepancy — focuses on mismatches between accounts or versions rather than logical contradiction
- {不整合|ふせいごう}: inconsistency — more technical term used in data, systems, and formal logic
